mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( IMGKEY integer NOT NULL, GROUP_KEY character varying(100), GROUP_CNT character varying(1), STATUS character varying(1) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, RSLT character varying(10), RSLTDESC character varying(1000), SENDABLE character varying(1) DEFAULT 'N' NOT NULL, BRAND_ID character varying(100) NOT NULL, IMG_PATH character varying(128), IMG_ID character varying(100), MEDIA_URL character varying(256), REQDATE timestamp NOT NULL, RPTDATE timestamp, TEMPLATE_YN character varying(1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_${tableName} PRIMARY KEY (IMGKEY) )
mapper.select: SELECT /* +RULE*/ IMGKEY AS key, IMG_PATH AS image_path, IMG_ID AS file_id, BRAND_ID, REQDATE AS request_date, TEMPLATE_YN FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '0' AND SENDABLE = 'N' AND REQDATE < NOW() LIMIT 100
SELECT IMGKEY AS key FROM ${tableName} WHERE STATUS = '1' AND REQDATE < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 seconds' LIMIT 100
